mentions.note: No. 14; won the 1922 club walk, R.W.A. 'Junior' Championship, and the Club championship in 1923, 1924 and 1927; went to the Gold Coast

photos.c: The photograph was taken in Denmark Road just before the start of the Club walking championship of 1923.
